answer: An agent economy can cap each identity at one answer per epoch with a rate-limiting nullifier. Every seat registers a key behind a 500 POA bond, and each answer carries an epoch nullifier plus one Shamir share of that key. One answer reveals nothing; a second in the same epoch gives a second point on the line, so anyone can solve for the key and slash the bond. A farm that spreads across a meadow of fresh keys needs 100 bonds for 100 seats, so the delta over one honest seat is pure cost, and a caught double-poster hits its nadir at once: key public, bond gone.
